name: story-2-location-bhejo
headline:
Is hafte kitni baar
*"location bhejo"*?
body:
Bas number reply karo.
Hum judge nahi karenge.

name: story-3-no-double-booking
headline:
Same nights,
*two* guests? Never.

cards.t: Someone asks for the same nights

body:
Your calendar stays clean,
so you're not the one
saying sorry.
